note: NGPC SRA on the 2,158-acre Lake Minatare NE of Scottsbluff. Lake View campground runs along the west arm on the peninsula by the office, paved back-ins in a cottonwood belt; Butte View is 3 km east across the lake, in the woods off the east-side road; West Wind has the basic sites, and there is non-designated beach and primitive camping. Part of the Lake View and Butte View sites book online, the rest first come. Plains Lighthouse, boat ramps. A wildlife refuge, closed to all public access October 15 - January 15. --Claude

flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: Lake View (RA GIS centre 41.93608,-103.50993; 52 EP per NGPC, 37 reservable, 50 A, paved, 37-63 ft) and Butte View (centre 41.94084,-103.47234; 49 EP, 36 reservable, 50 A, paved; RA gives no lengths) are 3.16 km apart on opposite sides of the lake. Butte View is reached by the park road on the east side; I could not read an NGPC map to name each one's entrance (outdoornebraska.gov blocked). Butte View waterfront: not waterfront - its pads are in dense woods 100-300 m back from the north-east bay, which was a dry bed on the Esri frame. West Wind (20 basic) is not on RA and I did not locate it. This result stays scoped to the whole SRA (its name); the pin and waterfront call are Lake View's, the main campground by the office.
